spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact new grammar (flow-start/flow-end) per alignment property via CSS.supports plus a setProperty retention round-trip, and explicitly refuses to infer support from flex-start working.

interactive.rationale: A live flexbox stage with value buttons, measured first-item offsets, and specified/computed readbacks; the matrix is generated at load from real probes.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the two-probe matrix plus live application with the honest dropped-value story; all delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the dropped-declaration path (with inline-value clearing so a stale value cannot masquerade as acceptance), the aliased-spelling fallback clearly labelled, and the serialization note when flex-* reads back as flow-*.

conformance.rationale: The new suite mirrors the matrix: per-property css-supports checks, the retention round-trip, both serialization contracts, and a passing divergence control.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 (cloud fallback, no chrome-devtools-mcp): all six properties reported false/(dropped) for both keywords; flow-start honestly reported dropped (computed stayed 'normal', item at 10px) including after a prior flex-end value; flex-end measured at 458px, center at 234px; zero console errors; both viewports clean.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the matrix ran, the supported-vs-fallback state as separate ids, and every application with its measured offset payload.

design_system.rationale: Token colours only, AAA verdict colours on paper/stone, 44px buttons, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: Matrix table has a caption and row/column scopes, buttons are native with visible focus, the readout is role=status aria-live=polite and reports offsets as text.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800: zero overflow, matrix wraps via overflow-wrap, identical probe results.

openQuestions.title: Re-run the matrix behind CSSFlowStartAndEnd on a 157+ binary
openQuestions.detail: Chromium 141 in this container predates the implementation (flags inert), so only the dropped branch has evidence. On a 157+ build with --enable-blink-features=CSSFlowStartAndEnd,CSSFlowStartAndEndSerialization, confirm the matrix flips per property and the flex-* buttons surface the flow-* serialization note.

guidanceConsulted.query: feature detect CSS value support graceful fallback
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Probe the exact property/value pair and keep the probe falsifiable; never infer support from adjacent shipped values.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each cell probes its own property with the exact keyword via CSS.supports AND a retention round-trip that clears the previous inline value first; flex-start support is explicitly called out as proving nothing.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel toggle buttons no horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Flex-wrap control rows with gap; avoid fixed-width stages.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Controls wrap and the flex stage is fluid; verified 0px document overflow at 360px.

summary: The exact-grammar probe for both keywords across six alignment properties, honest on Chromium 141 (all dropped, measured offsets unchanged), with the aliased flex-* spelling demonstrably applying the defined behaviour. Cloud headless verification, both viewports clean.
